assertions.assertion: CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is medically necessary
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia as a potential etiology for transient cerebral ischemic events
A cardiac event monitoring study is ordered to evaluate for intermittent cardiac abnormalities
Diagnosis code G45.9 supports the clinical presentation of transient cerebral symptoms
Diagnosis code R42 supports the clinical presentation of dizziness symptoms
